parts.note: to support someone is to back them
a team is a side, as in football

explanation.surface: A fan's loyalty to a club languishing at the foot of the league table.
explanation.definitionFit: The backside is the buttocks, a colloquial synonym of one's bottom.

definitions.meaning: in cricket a bowler delivers the ball
a basin or dish that holds things

explanation.definitionFit: To bowl is to deliver the ball in cricket, and a bowl is a round dish.

definitions.meaning: a brand of revolver made by Samuel ... company
a young male horse, the junior of the stable

explanation.definitionFit: A Colt is a revolver, and a colt is a young male horse, a junior animal.

indicators.note: reformed means formed anew, so the letters take another shape

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
taken as written

explanation.surface: A woman has changed her ways, or so one hopes.
explanation.definitionFit: Sophie is a girl's name, an example of a woman, a she.

clue.text: David starting to take possession on his way to his office?

definitions.text: David starting to take possession on his way to his office?

parts.words: David starting to take possession on his way to his office?
parts.note: a new prime minister named David moving into the London street where the PM's official residence stands

explanation.walkthrough: Published in 2010 as David Cameron became prime minister; the PM lives and works at Number 10 in this Westminster street.
explanation.definitionFit: The London street holds the Prime Minister's residence and office, Number 10.

clue.text: Agreement to deal with youth leader

parts.note: to treat a matter is to deal with it

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its opening letter, here of youth

explanation.surface: A deal struck to handle the head of a youth group.
explanation.definitionFit: A treaty is a formal agreement between nations or parties.

clue.text: Think over loss of one in miniature version

indicators.note: a version is a new rendering, so the remaining letters are rearranged
loss of means a piece is taken away from the word miniature

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I

explanation.surface: Pondering what is lost when something is shrunk down to scale.
explanation.walkthrough: MINIATURE without one I leaves MNIATURE, and 'version' rearranges those letters.
explanation.definitionFit: To ruminate is to think something over at length, as a cow chews the cud.

clue.text: Given as seaworthy — but not secure against pirates

parts.note: taken as written
a vessel fit to sail is sailable

explanation.surface: A ship declared fit for sea that is nonetheless open to raiders.
explanation.definitionFit: Assailable means open to attack, and pirates are attackers at sea.

parts.note: a date that, to a 2010 reader, was the twelvemonth just gone

explanation.walkthrough: The puzzle appeared in 2010, so 2009 was the previous year.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means last year, or more loosely times past.

parts.note: a will, the legal document, holds sway over those hoping to inherit; read whole, the phrase describes strength of mind

explanation.walkthrough: Split as WILL POWER it is the power a testator's will has over hopeful heirs; as one word it is self-control, one's hold over oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-control, one's hold over one's own impulses, is the everyday sense; the clue plays on a testament's power.

parts.note: George Stephenson's famous 1829 locomotive was the Rocket, so his advanced technology was the know-how behind it

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase for anything very advanced or hard is read as the engineering of Stephenson's Rocket locomotive.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means highly advanced, difficult knowledge, the cutting edge.

definitions.meaning: 6-down's answer means thinks over, so this is a verb meaning ponders deeply
the daughters of Zeus who inspire the arts were nine sisters

explanation.walkthrough: 'over' is a link. The nine sisters of Greek myth preside over epic, lyric, tragedy, comedy and the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: To muse is to ponder, and the Muses were nine goddess sisters of Greek mythology.

clue.text: Vince inside Tory leader could be off-putting

indicators.note: the letters of the preceding words could be rearranged into something else

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: the leader of Tory is its opening letter

explanation.surface: A Lib Dem politician inside a Conservative-led government might put voters off.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inside' looks like a container signal, but here it is part of what 'could be' rearranges. Vince Cable was a prominent Liberal Democrat politician; Tory means a British Conservative.
explanation.definitionFit: A disincentive is something that discourages, so used adjectivally it means off-putting.

parts.note: candid means frank and honest

indicators.note: overturned means the letters of the word seat are upset into a new order

explanation.surface: A politician's seat lost to frank challengers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'overturned' rearranges the four letters of the second word; 'by' is only a link joining the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Candidates are people applying for a job or standing for election.

clue.text: Chemical indicator lest it fail must be included

indicators.note: be included means the word must is put inside the other letters
to fail is to go wrong, so the letters go astray into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Advice on a lab test that must be done in case something goes wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fail' rearranges the six letters of 'lest it', and 'be included' sets the four-letter word inside them, after the third letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Litmus paper changes colour to show acidity, so this is a chemical indicator.

clue.text: Drug that may be indicated by 14 or an enquiry agency

definitions.text: Drug that may be indicated by 14

parts.note: an gives the letter A
the CID is the Criminal Investigation Department, the British police's detective branch

explanation.surface: A drug detectable by a chemical test, or perhaps by detectives.
explanation.walkthrough: 14-down is LITMUS TEST, which shows whether something is acidic. CID is the Criminal Investigation Department of British police forces.
explanation.definitionFit: Acid is slang for the drug LSD, and an acid is what litmus paper detects by turning red.

clue.text: Gandhi perhaps unknown to a large number

parts.note: Gandhi is an example of a great figure in history, a great man
in algebra y is an unknown quantity

explanation.surface: Gandhi, perhaps, was unfamiliar to plenty of people.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means a large number of things or people.

clue.text: One devoted woman at time of Flood

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
a nun is a woman devoted to religious life
a date is a point in time

explanation.surface: A pious woman at the time of Noah's Flood.
explanation.definitionFit: To inundate is to flood or overwhelm with water.

clue.text: To drop all value of French artist is English

parts.note: de is French for of
Claude Monet was a French Impressionist painter
taken as written

explanation.surface: A remark that the works of a French painter are English somehow strips them of worth.
explanation.definitionFit: To demonetise a coin or note is to withdraw it, so it has no value as money.

clue.text: Lamb found by prophet after losing some sheep

indicators.note: losing means the prophet's name drops a letter

parts.note: Elias is the New Testament form of the prophet Elijah's name

indicators.note: some of the word sheep, just its first letter

explanation.surface: A young sheep turns up with a prophet who has mislaid part of his flock.
explanation.walkthrough: Lamb is Charles Lamb, the English essayist who wrote as Elia; 'Lamb' looks like a young sheep, the surface's bait.
explanation.definitionFit: Charles Lamb published his Essays of Elia under that pen name.

clue.text: It's about time in spring to become less severe

parts.note: re means about or concerning
Lent is the Christian season before Easter, falling in spring

explanation.surface: A thought on the lenient mood of springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: To relent is to soften one's stance and become less harsh.

parts.note: 9-across read as the power of a testament: those it hurts are heirs cut out of the document

explanation.definitionFit: People cut out of a will lose their expected inheritance, the victims of a testament's power.

clue.text: Prima donna short of a bed

indicators.note: short of means the word for bed is cut short by its last letter

parts.note: a divan is a low bed

explanation.surface: An opera star left without a place to sleep.
explanation.definitionFit: A diva is a leading female opera singer, a prima donna.

definitions.meaning: a ... light is a signal flare fired from a pistol

explanation.definitionFit: Very means extremely, and a Very light is a coloured flare used as a signal.

parts.note: the definite article as in the Territorial Army's
TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: A badge belonging to the reserve soldiers.
explanation.walkthrough: The TA (Territorial Army) is Britain's part-time volunteer army; 'Volunteers'' read as 'the TA's' gives THE TA.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek letter is conventionally used in geometry to denote an angle.

indicators.note: mixed means these letters are jumbled into a new order

parts.note: the number nine spelt out
taken as written

explanation.surface: Nine fine assorted pieces of fruit.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' rearranges NINE and GREAT. 9 here is the number, not a cross-reference to 9-across.
explanation.definitionFit: A tangerine is a small citrus fruit like a mandarin.

parts.note: to have placed something is to have set it
a golf tee supports the ball

explanation.surface: A piece of furniture positioned to hold something up.
explanation.definitionFit: A settee is a sofa, an upholstered seat for several people.

indicators.note: unusual means the letters are arranged out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Remarking on a strange place to hang coats.
explanation.definitionFit: A vestiary is a room for keeping vestments or clothing, a cloakroom.
